compact.name: compact
compact.note: The smallest generally useful bounded item; it may shrink below its minimum only when the containing surface itself is narrower.

control.name: control
control.note: The default focused-control measure; fields remain fluid below the maximum.

content.name: content
content.note: A bounded content well that preserves useful line length and leaves shell gutters available.

wide.name: wide
wide.note: A wide bounded surface; it does not authorize a universal full-bleed layout.

reading.name: reading
reading.note: Reading is a text measure. Existing recipe rails may retain a ch-based Web projection while native consumes this numeric semantic bound.

fluid.name: fluid
avoidFor: a replacement for a content rail
fluid.note: Fill is an explicit opt-in; it does not change the owning shell or create a new max-width policy.

Stack.purpose: Arrange related content on one axis with tokenized gap and alignment.

responsiveIntent.wide: Preserve the authored axis and spacing.
responsiveIntent.constrained: Allow a row to wrap when the consumer opts in.
responsiveIntent.narrow: Stack only when the composition contract says order is preserved.

Stack.overflowContract: Children remain min-inline-size safe; no page overflow is created by the helper.
Stack.webRenderer: Flex column or row with shared gap variables.
Stack.nativeRenderer: View flex direction, gap equivalent, and platform alignment.

Cluster.purpose: Group peer actions or metadata with wrap-safe distribution.

responsiveIntent.wide: Keep peers on one row when their useful measures fit.
responsiveIntent.constrained: Wrap at content pressure rather than compressing labels.
responsiveIntent.narrow: Stack or scroll only when the recipe declares the alternate pattern.

Cluster.overflowContract: Wrap is the default; horizontal scroll is explicit and bounded to the owning region.
Cluster.webRenderer: A wrapping Stack or flex group composed by the recipe.
Cluster.nativeRenderer: A wrapping or stacked View group preserving reading order.

Inline.purpose: Keep short related content inline without assigning a universal width.

responsiveIntent.wide: Remain inline when content fits its useful measure.
responsiveIntent.narrow: Stack when wrapping would obscure relationship or affordance.

Inline.overflowContract: Text may wrap; controls never force document-level horizontal overflow.
Inline.webRenderer: Inline or flex composition owned by the consumer recipe.
Inline.nativeRenderer: Inline-like text composition or a row View with wrapping policy.

Grid.purpose: Arrange two-dimensional peers with explicit useful item geometry.

responsiveIntent.wide: Use intrinsic columns and retain peer alignment.
responsiveIntent.constrained: Reduce columns when useful item measures no longer fit.
responsiveIntent.narrow: Use one column or an explicitly alternate representation.

Grid.overflowContract: Grid tracks use minmax(0, 1fr) or a bounded item minimum; no implicit min-content track may escape the owner.
Grid.webRenderer: CSS Grid with intrinsic tracks and container-owned gaps.
Grid.nativeRenderer: FlatList/SectionList or measured flex rows selected by the native renderer.

AutoGrid.purpose: Fill available space with repeated items while respecting a minimum useful item measure.

responsiveIntent.wide: Auto-fill as many useful columns as the owning rail permits.
responsiveIntent.constrained: Drop columns before shrinking content below the item minimum.
responsiveIntent.narrow: Use the remaining useful column count without page overflow.

AutoGrid.overflowContract: Item minimum is bounded to the grid owner; overflow belongs to an explicit region, never the document by accident.
AutoGrid.webRenderer: ProductGrid CSS Grid auto-fill with a semantic item measure.
AutoGrid.nativeRenderer: Native collection layout using the same item intent and adaptive count.

Split.purpose: Keep two panes simultaneously useful in a desktop-oriented workspace.

responsiveIntent.wide: Resizable panes may remain side by side.
responsiveIntent.constrained: Clamp panes to useful minimums and let the recipe decide whether to stack.
responsiveIntent.narrow: Use the recipe's alternate list/detail or stacked pattern; do not squeeze two panes into unreadable columns.

Split.overflowContract: Each pane owns bounded scrolling; the split surface itself never becomes an accidental page-width source.
Split.webRenderer: CSS Grid with a keyboard- and pointer-resizable separator.
Split.nativeRenderer: Not a native component contract; use the adaptive MasterDetail pattern.

Sidebar.purpose: Provide persistent secondary navigation or context when the shell has room.

responsiveIntent.constrained: Collapse or become a user-invoked secondary surface.
responsiveIntent.narrow: Use MobileSidebar, drawer, or native navigation affordance.

Sidebar.overflowContract: Navigation owns its own scroll region; the document remains the primary scroll owner.
Sidebar.nativeRenderer: Native navigation, drawer, or tab surface selected by the shell.

Rail.purpose: Bound meaningful content without making every surface full bleed.

responsiveIntent.wide: Center the selected bounded rail inside shell gutters.
responsiveIntent.narrow: Use available width after safe gutters; preserve minimum useful content.

Rail.overflowContract: Rail width is bounded by its owner; long data uses a declared region strategy.
Rail.nativeRenderer: View/Text wrapper with resolved numeric max and gutter intent.

MasterDetail.purpose: Relate a collection to a selected record without losing context.

responsiveIntent.wide: Show master and detail together when both remain useful.
responsiveIntent.constrained: Retain the relationship while reducing pane width or using a bounded drawer.
responsiveIntent.narrow: Use list/detail navigation, a drawer, or a sheet while preserving selection and back behavior.

MasterDetail.overflowContract: The collection and detail owner may scroll independently only when the recipe declares it.
MasterDetail.webRenderer: SplitPane or a recipe-owned two-region layout.
MasterDetail.nativeRenderer: Native list/detail navigation or sheet, not a DOM split pane.

CenteredBoundedContent.purpose: Center content while retaining a useful intrinsic measure.

responsiveIntent.wide: Center within a named content or reading rail.
responsiveIntent.constrained: Remain fluid until the minimum useful surface is reached.
responsiveIntent.narrow: Use full available width after shell gutters.

CenteredBoundedContent.overflowContract: Centered content never relies on a fixed width larger than its containing block.
CenteredBoundedContent.webRenderer: Container with width: 100% and max-inline-size token.
CenteredBoundedContent.nativeRenderer: Centered View/Text block with numeric width constraints.

ScrollRegion.purpose: Give a bounded collection or surface an explicit scrolling owner.

responsiveIntent.wide: Use the owning region's natural height or declared bound.
responsiveIntent.constrained: Keep scrolling inside the bounded owner when context requires it.
responsiveIntent.narrow: Prefer document scroll unless a bounded collection contract justifies internal scroll.

ScrollRegion.overflowContract: No nested scroll is introduced without an owning label, bound, and keyboard/touch affordance.
ScrollRegion.nativeRenderer: ScrollView, FlatList, or SectionList selected by content semantics.

OverlayRegion.purpose: Present contextual work without changing the owning page composition.

responsiveIntent.wide: Use popup, popover, drawer, or modal according to task scope.
responsiveIntent.constrained: Prefer a bounded drawer or modal when popup space is insufficient.
responsiveIntent.narrow: Use a sheet or full-width contextual surface with preserved focus/back behavior.

OverlayRegion.overflowContract: The overlay owns its own scroll body and focus boundary; background page scroll is managed by the overlay contract.
OverlayRegion.webRenderer: Popup, Drawer, Modal, or AlertDialog with the shared overlay layer.
OverlayRegion.nativeRenderer: Native sheet, modal, or popover selected by task and platform convention.

examples: raw radius, elevation, and motion scales
FOUNDATION.note: Only named axes and foundational scales are authored here; component consumers do not copy raw values.

examples: foreground, background, surface, border, and focus
SEMANTIC.note: Semantic roles carry meaning; renderer projections choose CSS values or native values without changing the role.

examples: content, reading, compact, control, and wide measures
LAYOUT.note: Recipes may choose composition bounds; a native renderer may use a different arrangement while preserving reading order and intent.

examples: field, card, overlay, navigation, and collection roles
component radii, elevation, and interaction timing
COMPONENT.note: Components consume semantic roles and component tokens; product routes do not create parallel primitive values.

examples: neutral, AAPM, Academy, Publishing, Farm, and Operations selections
named recipe axes and justified brand semantic aliases
PRODUCT_PROFILE.note: Profiles select named token axes and approved brand aliases; they may not redefine generic component semantics.

SCOPE.note: A scope re-resolves the same contract; it is not a second provider, primitive library, or CSS token source.

dimensionClassifications.meaning: A named system axis intentionally selectable by a product or user.
Computed from typed foundation, semantic roles, recipe, or runtime preferences.
A stable system obligation whose meaning must not vary by route.
An approved product or brand selection, not a generic primitive value.
A component contract value shared by every consumer of that component.
A bounded arrangement measurement with no system-wide reuse obligation.

sourceOfTruth.webProjection: CSS custom properties generated from buildThemeVariables
sourceOfTruth.nativeProjection: typed JS/TS values generated from buildNativeThemeSnapshot

compatibility.legacyCssVariables: remain a Web delivery surface; they are not a native input or source of truth
compatibility.themeScope: re-resolves the same layers and may apply bounded semantic overrides

plain.label: Paper
plain.purpose: Reading, comparison and ordinary work. The plain API name is retained.

soft.label: Soft
soft.purpose: Quiet context and supporting category emphasis.

expressive.label: Expressive
expressive.purpose: Bounded data emphasis with a stronger tint and readable neutral text.

solid.label: Solid
solid.purpose: A strong KPI or decision signal with a centrally paired foreground.

inverse.label: Inverse
inverse.purpose: A deliberate neutral contrast chapter or focal decision.

viewport.behavior: Persistent rail becomes flowing secondary navigation; use MobileSidebar when a drawer is required.
Leading content hides at 700px. In PublicShell, links become a bounded horizontal row at 540px with 44px targets.
Comparable wide data uses a bounded horizontal scroll region or the existing stacked representation.
Recipes own grid transformations; use the shared gutters, reading rails and safe-area insets.

colorDomains.action: Brand and action; never evidence of successful state.
colorDomains.status: Fixed semantic meaning accompanied by a label or icon.
colorDomains.categorical: Ordered series independent of brand, accent and status; use labels and non-color differentiation.

ownership.scroll: One document scroll unless an explicit bounded region owns scrolling; popup root and native modal body lock remain canonical.
ownership.composition: Recipes own page arrangement; foundations own the shared language.
